purpose: Development-only nearest-prior-art control: signed weighted incumbent-informed pruning adapted from Liu et al. 2022, Algorithms 1/2.
reference_spins: Babai has coordinate code 2 (little-endian bits 0,1) in the four-value box; spins repeat +1,-1.
selection: Keep K pairs with smallest J_ij*b_i*b_j, where b is the Babai spin string. Preserve all original fields and retained coupling weights. No target labels enter selection.
limitations: Adaptation to weighted signed lattice Ising models with fields and a fixed K, not an exact reproduction of the MaxCut algorithm or its theoretical guarantees.
Only the already inspected 64 development cases; no use of the 128-case validation for method selection.
No new quantum hardware or noise runs; no novelty or quantum advantage claim.
Angle fit has the same 768-call budget as the saved comparison methods. Timings from separate runs are descriptive rather than a controlled speed benchmark.
